title: 幂等重跑：INSERT OVERWRITE 覆盖 vs INSERT INTO 追加
code:
# 幂等重跑：INSERT OVERWRITE 分区覆盖 vs INSERT INTO 追加（经典踩坑）
TARGET_PART = "dt=2026-03-01"
# 模拟一次任务产出的结果集：100 行，(sku, amount)
INPUT_ROWS = [("SKU" + str(i).rjust(3, "0"), 1 + i % 7) for i in range(100)]

STORE_OVERWRITE = {}
STORE_INTO = {}


def write_part(store, part, rows, mode):
    if mode == "overwrite":
        store[part] = list(rows)          # 整分区替换
    else:
        store.setdefault(part, []).extend(rows)   # 追加


def stat(store, part):
    rows = store.get(part, [])
    total = sum(a for _, a in rows)
    grain = len(set(s for s, _ in rows))
    dup = len(rows) - grain
    return len(rows), total, dup


def run_twice(store, mode, label):
    print("== " + label + " ==")
    results = []
    for rnd in (1, 2):
        write_part(store, TARGET_PART, INPUT_ROWS, mode)
        n, amt, dup = stat(store, TARGET_PART)
        results.append((n, amt, dup))
        print("  第 " + str(rnd) + " 次执行后 -> 行数=" + str(n) +
              " 金额合计=" + str(amt) + " 重复粒度键=" + str(dup))
    idempotent = (results[0] == results[1])
    print("  两次执行结果是否一致（幂等） = " + str(idempotent))
    print("  行数翻倍与否 = " + str(results[1][0] // results[0][0]) + " 倍")
    return results, idempotent


res_o, idem_o = run_twice(STORE_OVERWRITE, "overwrite",
                          "用例 A：INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE t PARTITION(dt='2026-03-01')")
print("")
res_i, idem_i = run_twice(STORE_INTO, "into",
                          "用例 B：INSERT INTO TABLE t PARTITION(dt='2026-03-01')")

print("")
print("== 第三次 WHERE 查询口径对比（下游报表读同一分区） ==")
n_o, amt_o, dup_o = stat(STORE_OVERWRITE, TARGET_PART)
n_i, amt_i, dup_i = stat(STORE_INTO, TARGET_PART)
print("  OVERWRITE 分区: 行数=" + str(n_o) + " 金额=" + str(amt_o) + " 重复粒度键=" + str(dup_o))
print("  INSERT INTO : 行数=" + str(n_i) + " 金额=" + str(amt_i) + " 重复粒度键=" + str(dup_i))
print("  金额虚增倍数 = " + str(round(amt_i / amt_o, 2)))
print("")
print("判据 1（OVERWRITE 重跑幂等：两次结果相同）: " + str(idem_o))
print("判据 2（INSERT INTO 重跑不幂等：行数翻倍）: " +
      str(not idem_i and res_i[1][0] == 2 * res_i[0][0]))
print("判据 3（INSERT INTO 产生重复粒度键 = " + str(dup_i) + " 个）: " + str(dup_i > 0))
print("判据 4（OVERWRITE 分区无重复粒度键）: " + str(dup_o == 0))
expected_output:
== 用例 A：INSERT OVERWRITE TABLE t PARTITION(dt='2026-03-01') ==
  第 1 次执行后 -> 行数=100 金额合计=395 重复粒度键=0
  第 2 次执行后 -> 行数=100 金额合计=395 重复粒度键=0
  两次执行结果是否一致（幂等） = True
  行数翻倍与否 = 1 倍

== 用例 B：INSERT INTO TABLE t PARTITION(dt='2026-03-01') ==
  第 1 次执行后 -> 行数=100 金额合计=395 重复粒度键=0
  第 2 次执行后 -> 行数=200 金额合计=790 重复粒度键=100
  两次执行结果是否一致（幂等） = False
  行数翻倍与否 = 2 倍

== 第三次 WHERE 查询口径对比（下游报表读同一分区） ==
  OVERWRITE 分区: 行数=100 金额=395 重复粒度键=0
  INSERT INTO : 行数=200 金额=790 重复粒度键=100
  金额虚增倍数 = 2.0

判据 1（OVERWRITE 重跑幂等：两次结果相同）: True
判据 2（INSERT INTO 重跑不幂等：行数翻倍）: True
判据 3（INSERT INTO 产生重复粒度键 = 100 个）: True
判据 4（OVERWRITE 分区无重复粒度键）: True
